meta.title: The Missing Cake
meta.intro: A village fête. A baking contest. Ten minutes before the judges sit down, the cherry cream cake that has taken first prize seven years running is gone. All that's left is an empty cake dome and a dachshund who looks extremely guilty.
meta.brief:
Incident: disappearance of a cherry cream cake (competition entry)
Location: clubhouse kitchen, summer fête
Time: Saturday, discovered at {time}
Reported by: Hilde Brettschneider
person.hilde.name: Hilde Brettschneider
person.hilde.bio: 79. Has baked with real butter since 1971 and will happily tell you so. Her cherry cream cake is practically the village landmark.
person.marlene.name: Marlene Vogt
person.marlene.bio: 54. Second to Hilde six years in a row. Flour on her apron, a marble cake in the running and a list of every bad call the judges have made since 2014.
person.timo.name: Timo Berger
person.timo.bio: Supposed to be handing out cake forks today. Keeps biscuits in every pocket and has had a tense relationship with the cream whipper since last week.
person.bruno.name: Bruno
person.bruno.bio: Seven years old. Very short legs, very long tongue. Sits by the back door with cream on his nose, looking into every camera like he has something to confess.
person.pia.name: Pia Okafor
person.pia.bio: Calm, precise, bone-dry. Brings an absurdly precise new gadget to every case. Today: a cream refractometer.
person.otto.name: Otto Brandl
person.otto.bio: Knows every village, every shortcut and every pea soup recipe in the county. The coffee machine in the van is broken. As always.
clue.fridge_note.detail: Stuck to the fridge door with a strawberry magnet, in thick marker pen: "TIMO! ONE more broken thing and you're banned from the kitchen. Dad"
clue.cherry_floor.detail: A single cherry, still wearing a dollop of cream, right at the back of the gap under the fridge. Things only roll under there if they hit the floor first.
clue.sugar_print: Shoe print in the icing sugar
clue.sugar_print.detail: Icing sugar is scattered in front of the counter, and in it one clean sole print. Moulded into the middle of the sole, clear as day: size 35.
clue.bruno_crumbs.detail: Golden crumbs are caught behind Bruno's collar. Butter biscuit, no doubt about it. The cream on his nose is only half the story.
clue.biscuit_pack.detail: In the pocket of the small rain jacket on the coat hook: an open packet of butter biscuits. Just enough are missing to lead a dachshund to the door.
clue.plate_crack.detail: At the bottom of the pedal bin, under a wad of kitchen roll: Hilde's cake plate with a fresh crack across it. What's left of the cake is still stuck to it.
scene.fridge_paper:
TIMO!
ONE more broken thing
and you're banned
from the kitchen.
Dad
fact.cake_there: At {time} the cake was still under its dome.
fact.hilde_jury: Hilde was waiting at the judges' table from {time} to {timeEnd}.
fact.marlene_jury: Marlene was at the judges' table from {time} to {timeEnd}. She was never in the kitchen.
fact.marlene_rival: Marlene has finished second to Hilde six times.
fact.timo_sent_in: At {time} Timo was sent into the kitchen on his own to fetch cake forks.
fact.crash: At {time} something crashed in the kitchen.
fact.cake_fell: Nobody stole the cake. It was dropped.
fact.small_shoe: Someone in size 35 shoes stood at the counter.
fact.timo_alone: At {time} Timo was alone in the kitchen when the cake fell.
fact.bruno_in_kitchen: At {time} Bruno was briefly in the kitchen.
fact.bruno_lured: Timo lured Bruno out of the kitchen with biscuits. All Bruno did was lick the cream off the floor.
fact.timo_biscuits: Timo always carries butter biscuits for Bruno.
fact.kitchen_ban: Timo's dad threatened to ban him from the kitchen if he broke one more thing.
fact.timo_afraid: Timo was scared of the kitchen ban, so he hid the accident.
stmt.s_h_cake: My cherry cream cake. Seven wins, and the same cake every time. At five past three it was still under the dome, I checked. At twenty past, the dome was empty.
stmt.s_h_where: I was waiting at the judges' table. And Marlene stood next to me the entire time, explaining everything that's wrong with my cream. For twenty minutes. So I know exactly where she was.
stmt.s_h_forks: The only one in the kitchen was Timo. Ralf sent him in just after three to fetch the cake forks. The rest of us were all outside.
stmt.s_h_bruno: It was the dog. Just look at his nose, it's covered in cream! I want him arrested. On a lead, if necessary.
stmt.s_h_bruno2: Dropped? And then tidied away? … Fine. A dachshund can't work a pedal bin, and he certainly doesn't cover things up with kitchen roll. I withdraw the accusation. For now.
stmt.s_h_plate: That's my cake plate! Cracked? Impossible. My cake does not fall. My cake stands. It has stood since 1971.
stmt.s_h_print: Size 35? That's a child's foot. I'm a 38, and I was outside.
stmt.s_h_note: Ralf is strict with that boy. Last week the boy lost control of the cream whipper and sprayed the ceiling. You can still see the marks.
stmt.s_m_cake: I know how this looks. Six times runner-up to Hilde, and today of all days her cake vanishes. But if I win, I win with my marble cake. Not because the competition disappeared.
stmt.s_m_flour: And yes, there's flour on my apron. At a baking contest that isn't suspicious. It's the entry requirement.
stmt.s_m_where: I was at the judges' table from three o'clock. Ask Hilde. I was explaining why her cream is too sweet. She'll have memorised every word.
stmt.s_m_crash: Around ten past three there was a crash from the kitchen. I assumed Ralf had dropped the baking trays again. He does it every year.
stmt.s_m_bruno: Bruno? He'll eat anything that hits the floor. But make a whole cake disappear, plate and all? That dog is ten inches tall.
stmt.s_m_plate: If the plate's in the bin, somebody dropped it and cleared up. Cakes don't jump off counters by themselves. Not even Hilde's.
stmt.s_m_print: Size 35? I'm a 41. Feel free to measure. There's only one person round here with feet that small.
stmt.s_m_biscuits: Timo always has butter biscuits in his jacket pocket. For Bruno. That dog can be bought for a biscuit.
stmt.s_m_note: Since the cream whipper incident, Ralf has been very strict. One more accident and Timo's on glass collecting duty outside. Forever.
stmt.s_t_cake: The cake? No idea. I was just… getting forks. Cake forks. They're over there.
stmt.s_t_where: Dad sent me in for the forks. Then I took Bruno outside. Marlene was outside the whole time, arguing with Mrs Brettschneider about cream.
stmt.s_t_bruno: It wasn't Bruno! He's not even allowed in the kitchen. Well, he was in for a bit. But he didn't do anything. Hardly anything.
stmt.s_t_plate: Maybe the plate was already broken? Plates just break sometimes. All on their own.
stmt.s_t_print: Size 35? Dunno exactly. Mum buys my shoes. Why is everyone looking at my feet?
stmt.s_t_biscuits: They're for Bruno. Show him a biscuit and he'll follow you anywhere. Even outside. Super handy.
stmt.s_t_note: That's because of the cream whipper. It was really old! Dad says one more broken thing and I'm banned from the kitchen. Till I'm eighteen.
stmt.s_b_cake: Bruno wags his tail. Then he licks his nose. Very thoroughly. For a very long time.
stmt.s_b_where: Bruno rolls onto his back and shows you his belly. This is not an alibi.
stmt.s_b_bruno: Bruno gazes deep into your eyes. Then he looks away, guiltily. He looks guilty about everything. Including the weather.
stmt.s_b_biscuits: At the word "biscuit", Bruno sits bolt upright and stares at the coat hooks by the back door.
accuse.ok: That holds up. How, when and why, all backed by evidence. I'll take the file.
accuse.reject.who: Your reasoning may be sound, but not for that person. Something doesn't fit.
accuse.reject.how: I'm not convinced by the how. What actually happened to the cake?
accuse.reject.when: I'm missing the opportunity. When and where is this supposed to have happened?
accuse.reject.why: The motive doesn't hold up. Why would anyone do this?
hint.h_fell.1: Right, let's recap. Nobody saw anyone leave the kitchen with a cake. Maybe it never left the kitchen at all.
hint.h_fell.2: By the back door it pays to look low: under the fridge and inside the pedal bin.
hint.h_fell.3: Connect the cherry and the plate with a blue thread. Both happened in the same moment.
hint.h_when.1: Right, let's recap. If the cake was dropped, someone was standing next to it. Who was even in the kitchen at the time?
hint.h_when.2: Take a close look at the floor in front of the counter. And ask Hilde where everyone was after three.
hint.h_when.3: A red thread from the shoe print to Hilde's statement about the cake forks.
hint.h_why.1: Right, let's recap. A kid drops a cake. Why tidy up in secret instead of owning up?
hint.h_why.2: There's something to read on the fridge door.
hint.h_why.3: A red thread from the fridge note to the cracked plate. That was the one broken thing too many.
hint.h_accuse.1: Right, let's recap. You've got the how, the when and the why. Time to see the prosecutor.
hint.h_accuse.2: The charge needs one person and three insight cards from the board.
hint.h_accuse.3: Timo, plus: the cake was dropped · Timo was alone in the kitchen · Timo was scared of the kitchen ban.
lab.otto_start: Otto here, in the lab van. The coffee machine's broken, but the radio works. Mostly.
lab.pia_cream: Cream. Thirty-two percent fat, bourbon vanilla, a trace of cherry juice. I only report what the nose tells me.
lab.pia_cherry: The cream on the cherry matches the cream on Bruno's nose. My refractometer doesn't lie. It won't tell me who ate what, though.
lab.pia_print: Icing sugar, very finely sifted. The print is fresh and has exactly one flaw: it's too small for an adult.
lab.pia_crumbs: Butter biscuit, standard packet, fifty-two scallops round the edge. I counted.
lab.otto_flask: My flask! I've been looking for that since the fire brigade barbecue. There's still coffee in it. I think.
lab.otto_solved: No villain, just a scared kid. The best cases are the ones that end with everybody having a slice of marble cake.
solution.text: At five past three, Ralf sends his son Timo into the kitchen for the cake forks. Timo only wants a quick peek under Hilde's dome. He lifts the cake, and it slips out of his hands. The plate cracks, a cherry rolls under the fridge, and Timo steps in the icing sugar. Bruno trots in and licks the cream off the floor. Now Timo panics: one more broken thing and he's banned from the kitchen. So he lures Bruno outside with biscuits, stuffs the packet back into his jacket and hides the plate and what's left of the cake under kitchen roll in the bin. Nobody stole anything. Marlene was at the judges' table the whole time, and Bruno is just a dachshund who found cream at exactly the right moment.
